c.v: The ESP32-S3 integrates an External Memory Encryption and Decryption module that complies with the
XTS_AES standard algorithm specified in IEEE Std 1619-2007
, providing security for users' application code and data stored in the external memory (flash and RAM).
Users can store proprietary firmware and sensitive data (e.g., credentials for gaining access to a private network) to the external flash, or store general data to the external RAM.
